## Who I Am

I am a current sophomore at Chaminade University of Honolulu, aiming to complete a Bachelor's degree in computer science, as well as a minor in data science. From a young age, I was interested in computers and their inner workings, which was supported by my father, a software engineer. Since then, I have studied several different coding languages like C#, Java, Javascript, C++, Python, as well as more data-orientated languages like SQL and R.
